A couple of weeks ago, out of necessity, I took my dog ​​in for a wash and a few areas to be clipped/cleaned. I explained carefully, as I have done for 11 years at the place where I usually wash her, the type of clipping she needed: cleaning the thighs and back of the butt, removing the ridges from the paws, trimming the lateral lengths and the gondola effect of the tail. I have no complaints about the washing and drying, which is essential for my dog, who has suffered from pyoderma. However, the grooming was completely transformed: the tail was SHORTENED, the lateral lengths were crooked, and the thighs and paws were left untrimmed. Now, all that's left of the shop are dozens and dozens of training certificates from the owner, whose expertise and skill precedes him in the words of everyone in eastern Rome. My dog, however, was poorly groomed by the assistant, who was clearly clumsy and is gaining more experience in the field and with our dogs. I'm so sorry, because I'm convinced he's truly talented, but I don't have the means to say so. He definitely wouldn't have cut the dog's tail almost in half, he would have trimmed the ridges on his legs, including how to clean the hair around his butt and thighs, and he would have used curved scissors for the sides, without having to trim further when the unevenness was pointed out.

We've been taking our cat here for grooming at least once a month for two years now, and he's always professionally bathed. His fur is always soft and smells good. We're very happy with the work these professionals do, and based on firsthand experience, I highly recommend taking your pet to them. The prices are excellent, and the results are exceptional. Thank you so much for the passion you put into your work. Highly recommended.
